about.metaTitle: About Activesite, web agency in Douala | Activesite
about.metaDescription: Activesite is a software company in Douala, Cameroon. We design and build websites and apps that help businesses win clients and scale.
about.title: We build software that wins you clients.
about.mission: Activesite is a full-service software company. We design and build websites, web apps and mobile apps that help businesses generate leads, win clients and scale faster.
about.partner: We are a technical and strategic partner for two kinds of people: founders and creators turning ideas into software products, and business owners using software to win clients and grow.

how.title: Goal-first
how.body: Every project starts with the result you need: leads, sales or sign-ups. Design and code serve that goal.

how.title: Fast
how.body: Small, focused scope and weekly progress. You see working pages early, not after months.

how.title: Measurable
how.body: We track every important action and commit to an outcome in writing.

founderBody: When I started Activesite, I kept meeting talented business owners who were invisible online. Their competitors were not better. They were simply easier to find and easier to trust.
I also met owners who had paid for websites that looked fine but brought nothing back. The agency had delivered pages. Nobody had asked how many clients the business needed.

That is the gap we close. Before we design anything, we agree on the result you want: more enquiries, more sales or a product people pay for. Then we build quickly, measure honestly and keep improving what works.
We are based in Douala and proud of it. We work with clients across Cameroon and abroad, in English and French, with the same standard everywhere.
If you are ready to grow, I would be glad to hear about your business. Book a call, and let’s see what your website could bring you.
